name: flipkart-fullstack
description: ShopKart (Flipkart-clone) — single-project workspace combining the Express/SQLite API (server/) and the React/Vite frontend (client/).

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
